title: Morning Brief — Monday, 16 November 2026
description: Australia pays the world's heaviest price in the global diesel supply crunch, Queensland unveils a four-lane upgrade design for the Bribie Island Bridge, and the Gold Coast expands its drone-based shark monitoring program ahead of summer. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
